# Load Packages

Below you can find the list of packages that are required for all analysis steps. 
```{r}
# Packages for data transformation
library(data.table)
library(readxl)  # for reading in excel files
library(tidyr)  # to separate IDs
library(rtracklayer)
library(reshape2)
library(oligo)
#library(dplyr)
#library(rvcheck)

# Color palettes
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Packages for plotting
library(VennDiagram)
library(UpSetR)
library(ggplot2)
library(qqman)  # for manhattan plots
library(ggpubr)  # for balloonplots
#library(ggplotify)
#library(ggforce)
```


# Paths

Before we can start, we need to make sure that all necessary paths and folder names are saved. If the output folder does not exist, we will generate it using the systems (Red Hat Enterprise Linux operating system: Fedora 25) "mkdir" command.
```{r}
# path to the eQTL result tables
results_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/04_result_tables"
# path to the clumped eQTL result tables
clumping_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/05_clumping/03_result_tables"
# path to SNP rdata GRanges files
rdata_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/06_RData_files"
# path to differentially expression analysis (DEA) hits
dea_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_DEA_results"
# path to expression data
expr_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/01_RData_files"
# path to CMC data
cmc_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2019_CMC_Fromer_et_al"
# path to GTEx data
gtex_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2019_GTEx_v8"
# path to fuma pathway results
fuma_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/07_FUMA"
# path to eQTS genes of ABMS
eqts_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_FUMA/4.1_input_files/"
# path to SNP-annotation data
anno_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/08_SNP-based_annotation"
# path to store the output into
out_path <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/09_figures"
# generate ouput path if not existing already
system(paste0("mkdir -p ", out_path))
```


# Functions

To reduce code, we will generate some functions here. 
```{r, echo = F}
# function, to get all genes, that can be found two or more times in a data sets
# @param genes    list of genes
get_duplicates <- function(genes) {
  genes_freq <- as.data.frame(table(genes))
  names(genes_freq) <- c("Gene", "Freq")
  genes_freq <- genes_freq[order(genes_freq$Freq, decreasing = T), ]
  print(genes_freq[genes_freq$Freq > 1, ])
  return(genes_freq)
}
```


# Load data

## Load eQTL hits

First, we will load all cis-eQTL datasets (already filtered for FDR < 0.05).
```{r, echo = F}
# Gene cis-eQTL cases and controls
eqtls_gene <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/01_pmb_cis-eQTL_gene_hits_cases_vs_controls.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
# Gene cis-eQTL cases only
eqtls_gene_cases <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/02_pmb_cis-eQTL_gene_hits_cases_only.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

# Transcript cis-eQTL cases and controls
eqtls_transcript <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/01_pmb_cis-eQTL_transcript_hits_cases_vs_controls.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
# Transcript cis-eQTL cases only
eqtls_transcript_cases <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/02_pmb_cis-eQTL_transcript_hits_cases_only.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

# Exon cis-eQTL cases and controls
eqtls_exon <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/01_pmb_cis-eQTL_exon_hits_cases_vs_controls.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
# Exon cis-eQTL cases only
eqtls_exon_cases <- fread(paste0(results_path, "/02_pmb_cis-eQTL_exon_hits_cases_only.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```
Then, we will check the number of found eQTLs and unique gene names in all datasets.

| | Genes | Genes cases | Transcripts | Transcripts cases | Exons | Exons cases |
|------|------|------|------|------|------|------|
| cis-eQTLs | `r length(eqtls_gene$SNP)` | `r length(eqtls_gene_cases$SNP)` | `r length(eqtls_transcript$SNP)` | `r length(eqtls_transcript_cases$SNP)` | `r length(eqtls_exon$SNP)` | `r length(eqtls_exon_cases$SNP)` |
| unique gene IDs | `r length(unique(eqtls_gene$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_gene_cases$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_transcript$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_transcript_cases$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_exon$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_exon_cases$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` |
| unique transcript IDs | - | - | `r length(unique(eqtls_transcript$"Ensembl Transcript ID"))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_transcript_cases$"Ensembl Transcript ID"))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_exon$"Ensembl Transcript ID"))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_exon_cases$"Ensembl Transcript ID"))` |
| unique exon IDs | - | - | - | - | `r length(unique(eqtls_exon$"Ensembl Exon ID"))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_exon_cases$"Ensembl Exon ID"))` |
| unique SNP IDs  | `r length(unique(eqtls_gene$SNP))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_gene_cases$SNP))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_transcript$SNP))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_transcript_cases$SNP))` | `r length(unique(eqtls_exon$SNP))` |`r length(unique(eqtls_exon_cases$SNP))` |

Now, we want to know, how many SNPs in median, min and max the eQTL genes have:
```{r, echo = F}
print(paste0("We found min ", min(table(as.data.frame(eqtls_gene[, "Ensembl Gene ID"]))), " SNP per gene and max ", max(table(as.data.frame(eqtls_gene[, "Ensembl Gene ID"]))), " SNPs per gene, with a median of ", median(table(as.data.frame(eqtls_gene[, "Ensembl Gene ID"]))), " genes"))
print(paste0("We found min ", min(table(as.data.frame(eqtls_transcript[, "Ensembl Transcript ID"]))), " SNP per transcript and max ", max(table(as.data.frame(eqtls_transcript[, "Ensembl Transcript ID"]))), " SNPs per transcript, with a median of ", median(table(as.data.frame(eqtls_transcript[, "Ensembl Transcript ID"]))), " transcripts"))
print(paste0("We found min ", min(table(as.data.frame(eqtls_exon[, "Ensembl Exon ID"]))), " SNP per exon and max ", max(table(as.data.frame(eqtls_exon[, "Ensembl Exon ID"]))), " SNPs per exon, with a median of ", median(table(as.data.frame(eqtls_exon[, "Ensembl Exon ID"]))), " exons"))
```

Then, we will check the number of found eQTLs and unique gene names in all datasets.

## Load DEGene hits

Load tDEGenes (6 hits) and eDEGenes (2,223 hits). 
```{r, echo = F}
# tDEGenes
tDEGenes <- fread(paste0( dea_path, "/2.4_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), data.table = F, stringsAsFactors = F)
tDEGenes <- tDEGenes[tDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID` <- sapply(unlist(strsplit(tDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])

# eDEGenes
eDEGenes <- fread(paste0(dea_path, "/3.4_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), data.table = F, stringsAsFactors = F)
eDEGenes <- eDEGenes[eDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID` <- sapply(unlist(strsplit(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])
```
Then, we will check the number of found DEGenes:

|      | hits |
|------|------|
| tDEGenes | `r length(tDEGenes$"Ensembl Gene ID")` |
| eDEGenes | `r length(eDEGenes$"Ensembl Gene ID")` |

## Load eQTS hits

Load all interesting eQTS gene hits. only the ABMS combined dataset including ADHD-2019, BIP-2019, MDD-2019 and SCZ-2014 eQTS hits. 
```{r, echo = F}
# Load ADHD-2019 eQTS
adhd <- fread(paste0(dea_path, "/3.5.1_diff_expr_exons_for_ADHD-2019_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), header = T, data.table = F, stringsAsFactors = F)
adhd <- adhd[adhd$`FDR estimate` <= 0.1, ]
# Load ASD-2019 eQTS
asd <- fread(paste0(dea_path, "/3.5.2_diff_expr_exons_for_ASD-2019_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), header = T, data.table = F, stringsAsFactors = F)
asd <- asd[asd$`FDR estimate` <= 0.1, ]
# Load BIP-2019 eQTS
bip <- fread(paste0(dea_path, "/3.5.3_diff_expr_exons_for_BIP-2019_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), header = T, data.table = F, stringsAsFactors = F)
bip <- bip[bip$`FDR estimate` <= 0.1, ]
# Load CDG-2019 eQTS
cdg <- fread(paste0(dea_path, "/3.5.7_diff_expr_exons_for_CDG2-2019_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), header = T, data.table = F, stringsAsFactors = F)
cdg <- cdg[cdg$`FDR estimate` <= 0.1, ]
# Load MDD-2019 eQTS
mdd <- fread(paste0(dea_path, "/3.5.13_diff_expr_exons_for_MDD3-2019_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), header = T, data.table = F, stringsAsFactors = F)
mdd <- mdd[mdd$`FDR estimate` <= 0.1, ]
# Load SCZ-2014 eQTS
scz <- fread(paste0(dea_path, "/3.5.14_diff_expr_exons_for_SCZ2-2014_PRS_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv"), header = T, data.table = F, stringsAsFactors = F)
scz <- scz[scz$`FDR estimate` <= 0.1, ]
# Load ABMS eQTS
abms <- fread(paste0(eqts_path, "/3_exon_eQTS_ADHD_BIP_MDD_SCZ.txt"), data.table = F, stringsAsFactors = F, header = F)
```
Check t-statistic ranges and median:

|      | range | median |
|------|-------|--------|
| ADHD eQTS | `r min(adhd$"T-statistic")` - `r max(adhd$"T-statistic")` | `r median(adhd$"T-statistic")` |
| ASD eQTS | `r min(asd$"T-statistic")` - `r max(asd$"T-statistic")` | `r median(asd$"T-statistic")` |
| BIP eQTS | `r min(bip$"T-statistic")` - `r max(bip$"T-statistic")` | `r median(bip$"T-statistic")` |
| CDG eQTS | `r min(cdg$"T-statistic")` - `r max(cdg$"T-statistic")` | `r median(cdg$"T-statistic")` |
| MDD eQTS | `r min(mdd$"T-statistic")` - `r max(mdd$"T-statistic")` | `r median(mdd$"T-statistic")` |
| SCZ eQTS | `r min(scz$"T-statistic")` - `r max(scz$"T-statistic")` | `r median(scz$"T-statistic")` |

Then, we only get the unique gene IDs for all eQTS:
```{r}
adhd <- unique(as.vector(sapply(adhd$`Ensembl Gene ID`, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
asd <- unique(as.vector(sapply(asd$`Ensembl Gene ID`, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
bip <- unique(as.vector(sapply(bip$`Ensembl Gene ID`, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
cdg <- unique(as.vector(sapply(cdg$`Ensembl Gene ID`, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
mdd <- unique(as.vector(sapply(mdd$`Ensembl Gene ID`, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
scz <- unique(as.vector(sapply(scz$`Ensembl Gene ID`, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
```

Then, we will check the number of found ABMS eQTS genes:

|      | hits |
|------|------|
| ADHD eQTS | `r length(adhd)` |
| ASD eQTS | `r length(asd)` |
| BIP eQTS | `r length(bip)` |
| CDG eQTS | `r length(cdg)` |
| MDD eQTS | `r length(mdd)` |
| SCZ eQTS | `r length(scz)` |
| ABMS eQTS | `r length(abms$V1)` |


# Overlaps to other resources

Before, we can do the overlaps, we need to remove the endings from the Ensembl gene IDs from the eGenes.
```{r, echo = F}
# for all eGenes remove endings from the Ensembl Gene IDs for the overlap to CMC
geGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(unlist(strsplit(eqtls_gene$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
length(geGenes)
teGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(unlist(strsplit(eqtls_transcript$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
length(teGenes)
eeGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(unlist(strsplit(eqtls_exon$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
length(eeGenes)
```


## CMC

And the CMC Fromer et al. Paper.

### gDEGenes

```{r, echo = F}
# load data
cmc_gDEGenes <- as.data.frame(read_excel(paste0(cmc_path, "/nn.4399-S5.xlsx"), sheet = "Genes", skip = 1))
cmc_gDEGenes <- unique(cmc_gDEGenes[cmc_gDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.05, "Ensembl Gene ID"])  # filter for FDR < 0.05

# get overlap from eGenes to CMC gDEGenes
print(paste0("Unique CMC gDEGenes (Ensembl Gene IDs): ", length(cmc_gDEGenes)))
print(paste0("Overlap CMC gDEGenes to geGenes: ", length(intersect(cmc_gDEGenes, geGenes)), " (", length(intersect(cmc_gDEGenes, geGenes)) / (length(geGenes) / 100), "%)"))
print(paste0("Overlap CMC gDEGenes to teGenes: ", length(intersect(cmc_gDEGenes, teGenes)), " (", length(intersect(cmc_gDEGenes, teGenes)) / (length(teGenes) / 100), "%)"))
print(paste0("Overlap CMC gDEGenes to eeGenes: ", length(intersect(cmc_gDEGenes, eeGenes)), " (", length(intersect(cmc_gDEGenes, eeGenes)) / (length(eeGenes) / 100), "%)"))
```

## GTEx

Now, we want to know the overlap to the GTEx differentially expressed genes and isoforms. Therefore, we will use the Prefrontal Cortex BA9 region only.

## DEGenes

```{r, echo = F}
# load data
gtex_gDEGenes <- fread(paste0(gtex_path, "/GTEx_Analysis_v8_eQTL_expression_matrices/Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9.v8.normalized_expression.bed.gz"), data.table = F, select = "gene_id")
gtex_gDEGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(gtex_gDEGenes$gene_id, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))  # remove the endings from the IDs

# get overlap from eGenes to GTEx gDEGenes
print(paste0("Unique GTEx gDEGenes (Ensembl Gene IDs): ", length(gtex_gDEGenes)))
print(paste0("Overlap GTEx gDEGenes to geGenes: ", length(intersect(gtex_gDEGenes, geGenes)), " (", length(intersect(gtex_gDEGenes, geGenes)) / (length(geGenes) / 100), "%)"))
print(paste0("Overlap GTEx gDEGenes to teGenes: ", length(intersect(gtex_gDEGenes, teGenes)), " (", length(intersect(gtex_gDEGenes, teGenes)) / (length(teGenes) / 100), "%)"))
print(paste0("Overlap GTEx gDEGenes to eeGenes: ", length(intersect(gtex_gDEGenes, eeGenes)), " (", length(intersect(gtex_gDEGenes, eeGenes)) / (length(eeGenes) / 100), "%)"))
```

## sDEGenes

```{r, echo = F}
# load data
gtex_sDEGenes <- fread(paste0(gtex_path, "/GTEx_Analysis_v8_sQTL_phenotype_matrices/Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9.v8.leafcutter_phenotypes.bed.gz"), data.table = F, select = "ID")
gtex_sDEGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(gtex_sDEGenes$ID, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][5], "\\.")[[1]][1])))  # remove the endings from the IDs

# get overlap from eGenes to GTEx DEGenes
print(paste0("Unique GTEx sDEGenes (Ensembl Gene IDs): ", length(gtex_sDEGenes)))
print(paste0("Overlap GTEx sDEGenes to geGenes: ", length(intersect(gtex_sDEGenes, geGenes)), " (", length(intersect(gtex_sDEGenes, geGenes)) / (length(geGenes) / 100), "%)"))
print(paste0("Overlap GTEx sDEGenes to teGenes: ", length(intersect(gtex_sDEGenes, teGenes)), " (", length(intersect(gtex_sDEGenes, teGenes)) / (length(teGenes) / 100), "%)"))
print(paste0("Overlap GTEx sDEGenes to eeGenes: ", length(intersect(gtex_sDEGenes, eeGenes)), " (", length(intersect(gtex_sDEGenes, eeGenes)) / (length(eeGenes) / 100), "%)"))
```

# Figures 

## Barplot

First, we generate a barplot only including the number of found gene, transcript and exon level eQTLs. 
```{r}
eqtls <- c(length(eqtls_gene$SNP), length(eqtls_transcript$SNP), length(eqtls_exon$SNP))
type <- c("gene", "transcript", "exon")
eqtls_all <- data.frame(eqtls, type)
eqtls_all$type <- factor(eqtls_all$type, levels = c("gene", "transcript", "exon"))
g <- ggplot(eqtls_all, aes(y = eqtls, x = type, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, size = 2), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) +
  ylab("# significant hits") +
  xlab("") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 500000, 200000)) + 
  geom_text(size = 7, aes(label = eqtls), nudge_y = 120, colour = "dimgray") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(3, option = "D", begin = 0.15, end = 0.9))
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(out_path, "/1_barplots_significant_eQTLs_gene_transcript_exon_new_pvalues_and_fdr.pdf"), width = 6, height = 4)
g
rm(eqtls_all)
```

## VENN diagrams

### Overlap eeGenes to eDEGenes

```{r}
edegenes_all <- unique(eDEGenes$`Ensembl Gene ID`)
eegenes_all <- unique(unlist(lapply(eqtls_exon$`Ensembl Gene ID`, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
pdf(paste0(out_path, "/2_VENN_diagram_eeGenes_vs_eDEGenes.pdf"))
grid.newpage()
draw.pairwise.venn(area1 = length(edegenes_all), 
                   area2 = length(eegenes_all), scaled = T, lty = "blank",
                   cross.area = length(intersect(edegenes_all, eegenes_all)), 
                   category = c(paste("eDEGenes", length(edegenes_all), sep = "\n"),
                                paste("eeGenes", length(eegenes_all), sep = "\n")), 
                   fill = c(rgb(red = 66, green = 146, blue = 198, maxColorValue = 255), 
                            rgb(red = 158, green = 212, blue = 0, maxColorValue = 255)))
dev.off()
```

### SNP level

First we will generate the VENN diagram for the cases and control datasets. 
```{r, include = F, eval = F, echo = F}
genes_all <- unique(eqtls_gene$SNP)
transcripts_all <- unique(eqtls_transcript$SNP)
exons_all <- unique(eqtls_exon$SNP)

grid.newpage()
overrideTriple = T
draw.triple.venn(area1 = length(genes_all), area2 = length(transcripts_all), 
                 area3 = length(exons_all),  
                 n12 = length(intersect(genes_all, transcripts_all)), 
                 n23 = length(intersect(transcripts_all, exons_all)), 
                 n13 = length(intersect(genes_all, exons_all)), 
                 n123 = length(intersect(genes_all, intersect(transcripts_all, exons_all))),
                 reverse = FALSE, euler.d = F, scaled = F, lty = "blank",
                 category = c(paste("geSNPs", length(genes_all), sep = "\n"), 
                              paste("teSNPs", length(transcripts_all), sep = "\n"), 
                              paste("eeSNPs", length(exons_all), sep = "\n")),
                 fill = c(rgb(red = 255, green = 167, blue = 42, maxColorValue = 255), 
                          rgb(red = 66, green = 146, blue = 198, maxColorValue = 255),
                          rgb(red = 158, green = 212, blue = 0, maxColorValue = 255)))
dev.off()
```

## Manhattan Plots

We will generate manhattan plots using the qqman package (easiest way) and save them into a pdf file. We will start with the gene eSNPs:
```{r, echo = F}
# transform gene eQTL hits
eqtls_gene_manhattan <- as.data.frame(eqtls_gene[, c("SNP", "P-value", "SNP Location")])
eqtls_gene_manhattan <- separate(eqtls_gene_manhattan, "SNP Location", c("Chr", "BP"))
eqtls_gene_manhattan$Chr <- as.numeric(eqtls_gene_manhattan$Chr)
eqtls_gene_manhattan$BP <- as.numeric(eqtls_gene_manhattan$BP)
# generate manhattan plot
pdf(paste0(out_path, "/3_manhattan_plot_gene_eSNPs_FDR_0.05.pdf"), width = 21, height = 7)
manhattan(eqtls_gene_manhattan, chr = "Chr", bp = "BP", snp = "SNP", p = "P-value", suggestiveline = F, genomewideline = F, ylim = c(3, 30), col = c(viridis(3, option = "D", begin = 0.15, end = 0.9)[1], "gray"))
dev.off()
manhattan(eqtls_gene_manhattan, chr = "Chr", bp = "BP", snp = "SNP", p = "P-value", suggestiveline = F, genomewideline = F, ylim = c(3, 30), col = c(viridis(3, option = "D", begin = 0.15, end = 0.9)[1], "gray"))
rm(eqtls_gene_manhattan)
```

## Combined boxplots of top exon eQTL

Generate boxplot of gene, transcript and exon expression for one eQTL (SNP-gene pair). Top exon hit without a gene hit is SNP rs505460 with exon ENSE00001231633.1 of gene NCALD:
```{r, echo = F}
# unoverlapping genes
no_overlap <- setdiff(eqtls_exon$`Gene Symbol`, eqtls_gene$`Gene Symbol`)
length(no_overlap) # 5,646
# overlapping genes
overlap <- intersect(eqtls_exon$`Gene Symbol`, eqtls_gene$`Gene Symbol`)
length(overlap) # 67.76% (n = 755) of 1,114 unique eQTL genes have an exon hit, while 5,646 eQTL genes out of 6,401 are only found with exons
# plot 2 Bsp overlap vs. non
exon_only <- eqtls_exon[eqtls_exon$`Gene Symbol` %in% no_overlap, ]
# get top hit
#exon_only[which.min(exon_only$FDR), ]
exon_only[3, ]

# load necessary mapping and expression data
load(paste0(expr_path, "/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_gene_summaries_annotated.RData"))
load(paste0(expr_path, "/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_transcript_summaries_annotated.RData"))
load(paste0(expr_path, "/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_exon_summaries_annotated.RData"))
huex <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2018_MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/HuEx-1_0-st-v2/HuEx-1_0-st-v2.na36.hg19.probeset.csv", data.table = F, skip = 22)
huex <- huex[huex$start != "---", ]  # remove ids with no start and stop information
genecode <- as.data.frame(import.gff("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2018_MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/annotation_files/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf", format = "gtf"))
# get gene expression
gene_id <- genecode[genecode$gene_name == "NCALD" & genecode$type == "gene", "gene_id"]
gene_exprs <- t(exprs(gene_summaries[featureNames(gene_summaries) %in% gene_id, ])) # get expression of gene
# get transcript expression (only transcripts including the interesting exon)
transcript_ids <- genecode[genecode$gene_name == "NCALD" & genecode$type == "transcript" & genecode$transcript_name %in% c("NCALD-201", "NCALD-011", "NCALD-013", "NCALD-008"), "transcript_id"] 
transcript_exprs <- as.data.frame(204)
for (i in transcript_ids) {
  expr <- t(exprs(transcript_summaries[grep(i, featureNames(transcript_summaries)), ]))
  transcript_exprs <- cbind(transcript_exprs, expr)
}
transcript_exprs$`204` <- NULL
# get exon expression (only interesting exon/s)
exon_ids <- c("ENSE00001231633.1", "ENSE00002113070.1", "ENSE00002097865.1", "ENSE00002129643.1") # just take the interesting exons
exon_exprs <- as.data.frame(204)
for (i in exon_ids) {
  expr <- t(exprs(exon_summaries[grep(i, featureNames(exon_summaries)), ]))
  exon_exprs <- cbind(exon_exprs, expr)
}
exon_exprs$`204` <- NULL
# merge all three data sets
gt <- merge(gene_exprs, transcript_exprs, by = "row.names")
gte <- merge(gt, exon_exprs, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = "row.names")
head(gte)
save(gte, file = paste0(out_path, "/NCALD_rs505460_gene_transcript_exon_expression.RData"))

# snp data
system(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/tools/PLINK/plink --bfile /storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/01_preprocessed_genotypes/1.3_samples_filtered/pmb_info06_all_chr_maf0.05_merged --snp rs505460 --recode --tab --out NCALD_SNPs"))
snp <- read.delim("NCALD_SNPs.ped", head = T)
pheno <- pData(gene_summaries)[, c("IID","Dx")]

exp_p_snp <- merge(exp_p, snp, by.x = "IID", by.y = "X2.1")
```

Box plots of rs34435097 and FEZ1 gene (ENSG00000149557.8; exon: ENSE00002189829.1, chr: 11) and using Gviz package to generate a plot including the chromosome, all transcripts and annotations for chromatin, vep, etc. (see DeepWAS plot): it is an eeSNP enrichment for stop gain, MDD3 & EA eQTS and it is a GTEX BA9 sQTL, but no eQTL! This SNP helps to argue for using only exon results.
```{r, include = F, eval = F, echo = F}
library(Gviz)
# get exons
exons <- eqtls_exon[eqtls_exon$`Ensembl Exon ID` == "ENSE00002189829.1" & eqtls_exon$SNP == "rs34435097", ]

# load necessary mapping and expression data
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/01_RData_files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_gene_summaries_annotated.RData")
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/01_RData_files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_transcript_summaries_annotated.RData")
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/01_RData_files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_exon_summaries_annotated.RData")
huex <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2018_MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/HuEx-1_0-st-v2/HuEx-1_0-st-v2.na36.hg19.probeset.csv", data.table = F, skip = 22)
huex <- huex[huex$start != "---", ]  # remove ids with no start and stop information
gene_code <- as.data.frame(import.gff("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2018_MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/annotation_files/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf", format = "gtf"))
# get gene expression
gene_id <- gene_code[gene_code$gene_name == "NCALD" & gene_code$type == "gene", "gene_id"]
gene_exprs <- t(exprs(geneSummaries[featureNames(geneSummaries) %in% gene_id, ])) # get expression of gene
# get transcript expression (only transcripts including the interesting exon)
transcript_ids <- gene_code[gene_code$gene_name == "NCALD" & gene_code$type == "transcript" & gene_code$transcript_name %in% c("NCALD-201", "NCALD-011", "NCALD-013", "NCALD-008"), "transcript_id"] 
transcript_exprs <- as.data.frame(204)
for (i in transcript_ids) {
  expr <- t(exprs(transcriptSummaries[grep(i, featureNames(transcriptSummaries)), ]))
  transcript_exprs <- cbind(transcript_exprs, expr)
}
transcript_exprs$`204` <- NULL
# get exon expression (only interesting exon/s)
exon_ids <- c("ENSE00001231633.1", "ENSE00002113070.1", "ENSE00002097865.1", "ENSE00002129643.1") # just take the interesting exon
exon_exprs <- as.data.frame(204)
for (i in exon_ids) {
  expr <- t(exprs(exonSummaries[grep(i, featureNames(exon_summaries)), ]))
  exon_exprs <- cbind(exon_exprs, expr)
}
exon_exprs$`204` <- NULL
# merge all three data sets
gt <- merge(gene_exprs, transcript_exprs, by = "row.names")
gte <- merge(gt, exon.exprs, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = "row.names")
head(gte)
save(gte, file = "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/NCALD_rs505460_gene_transcript_exon_expression.RData") 

# snp data

snp <- read.delim("NCALD_SNPs.ped", head = T)
pheno <- pData(geneSummaries)[, c("IID","Dx")]

exp_p <- merge(gte, pheno, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = "row.names")
exp_p_snp <- merge(exp.p, snp, by.x = "IID", by.y = "X1.1")
save(exp_p_snp, file <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/NCALD_gene_transcript_exon_expression_snp.rda")

# Generate plot
plot_data <- melt(exp_p_snp, id.vars = "A.A", measure.vars = c("ENSG00000104490.13", grep("ENS", colnames(exp_p_snp), value = T)))
plot_data <- plot_data[plot_data$A.A != "0 0",]
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/figures/5_boxplots_NCALD_rs505460_gene_transcript_exon_expression_snp.pdf")

        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)) +
  xlab("rs505460") + ylab("expression")
dev.off()
```

## Distance plots

Calculate the distances between the SNPs and genes/transcripts/exons in the cis-eQTLs.
```{r, include = F, eval = F, echo = F}
### GENE eQTL ALL ###
# 1. separate SNP chromosome from position
eqtls_gene$SNP_chr <- lapply(eqtls_gene$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1])
eqtls_gene$SNP_pos <- lapply(eqtls_gene$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2])
eqtls_gene$Gene_chr <- lapply(eqtls_gene$`Gene Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1], "chr")[[1]][2])
eqtls_gene$Gene_start <- lapply(eqtls_gene$`Gene Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][1])
eqtls_gene$Gene_end <- lapply(eqtls_gene$`Gene Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][2])
# check visually if chromosomes of SNP and gene are equal
chromosomes <- as.data.frame(eqtls_gene[, c("SNP_chr", "Gene_chr")])
chromosomes[!duplicated(chromosomes),] 
eqtls_gene <- as.data.frame(eqtls_gene)

### GENE eQTL CASES only ###
eqtls_gene_cases$SNP_chr <- lapply(eqtls_gene_cases$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1])
eqtls_gene_cases$SNP_pos <- lapply(eqtls_gene_cases$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2])
eqtls_gene_cases$Gene_chr <- lapply(eqtls_gene_cases$`Gene Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1], "chr")[[1]][2])
eqtls_gene_cases$Gene_start <- lapply(eqtls_gene_cases$`Gene Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][1])
eqtls_gene_cases$Gene_end <- lapply(eqtls_gene_cases$`Gene Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][2])
# check visually if chromosomes of SNP and gene are equal
chromosomes <- as.data.frame(eqtls_gene_cases[, c("SNP_chr", "Gene_chr")])
chromosomes[!duplicated(chromosomes),] 
eqtls_gene_cases <- as.data.frame(eqtls_gene_cases)

### Transcript eQTL ALL ###
eqtls_transcript$SNP_chr <- lapply(eqtls_transcript$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1])
eqtls_transcript$SNP_pos <- lapply(eqtls_transcript$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2])
eqtls_transcript$Transcript_chr <- lapply(eqtls_transcript$`Transcript Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1], "chr")[[1]][2])
eqtls_transcript$Transcript_start <- lapply(eqtls_transcript$`Transcript Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][1])
eqtls_transcript$Transcript_end <- lapply(eqtls_transcript$`Transcript Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][2])
# check visually if chromosomes of SNP and gene are equal
chromosomes <- as.data.frame(eqtls_transcript[, c("SNP_chr", "Transcript_chr")])
chromosomes[!duplicated(chromosomes),] 
eqtls_transcript <- as.data.frame(eqtls_transcript)

### Transcript eQTL CASES only ###
eqtls_transcript_cases$SNP_chr <- lapply(eqtls_transcript_cases$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1])
eqtls_transcript_cases$SNP_pos <- lapply(eqtls_transcript_cases$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2])
eqtls_transcript_cases$Transcript_chr <- lapply(eqtls_transcript_cases$`Transcript Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1], "chr")[[1]][2])

eqtls_transcript_cases$Transcript_end <- lapply(eqtls_transcript_cases$`Transcript Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][2])
# check visually if chromosomes of SNP and gene are equal
chromosomes <- as.data.frame(eqtls_transcript_cases[, c("SNP_chr", "Transcript_chr")])
chromosomes[!duplicated(chromosomes),] 
eqtls_transcript_cases <- as.data.frame(eqtls_transcript_cases)

### Exon eQTL ALL ###
eqtls_exon$SNP_chr <- lapply(eqtls_exon$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1])
eqtls_exon$SNP_pos <- lapply(eqtls_exon$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2])
eqtls_exon$Exon_chr <- lapply(eqtls_exon$`Exon Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1], "chr")[[1]][2])
eqtls_exon$Exon_start <- lapply(eqtls_exon$`Exon Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][1])
eqtls_exon$Exon_end <- lapply(eqtls_exon$`Exon Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][2])
# check visually if chromosomes of SNP and gene are equal
chromosomes <- as.data.frame(eqtls_exon[, c("SNP_chr", "Exon_chr")])
chromosomes[!duplicated(chromosomes),] 
eqtls_exon <- as.data.frame(eqtls_exon)

### Exon eQTL CASES only ###
eqtls_exon_cases$SNP_chr <- lapply(eqtls_exon_cases$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1])
eqtls_exon_cases$SNP_pos <- lapply(eqtls_exon_cases$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2])
eqtls_exon_cases$Exon_chr <- lapply(eqtls_exon_cases$`Exon Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1], "chr")[[1]][2])
eqtls_exon_cases$Exon_start <- lapply(eqtls_exon_cases$`Exon Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][1])
eqtls_exon_cases$Exon_end <- lapply(eqtls_exon_cases$`Exon Location`, function(x) strsplit(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], "\\.\\.")[[1]][2])
# check visually if chromosomes of SNP and gene are equal
chromosomes <- as.data.frame(eqtls_exon_cases[, c("SNP_chr", "Exon_chr")])
chromosomes[!duplicated(chromosomes),] 
eqtls_exon_cases <- as.data.frame(eqtls_exon_cases)


# 2. get distance between gene and SNP
# Gene eQTLS ALL
dist.gene <- unlist(lapply(1:length(eqtls_gene$SNP), function(x) if(as.numeric(eqtls_gene[x, "SNP_pos"]) < as.numeric(eqtls_gene[x, "Gene_start"])){ as.numeric(eqtls_gene[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_gene[x, "Gene_start"])} else if(as.numeric(eqtls_gene[x, "SNP_pos"]) > as.numeric(eqtls_gene[x, "Gene_end"])){as.numeric(eqtls_gene[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_gene[x, "Gene_end"])} else {0}))

# Gene eQTLS CASES only
dist.gene.cases <- unlist(lapply(1:length(eqtls_gene_cases$SNP), function(x) if(as.numeric(eqtls_gene_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) < as.numeric(eqtls_gene_cases[x, "Gene_start"])){ as.numeric(eqtls_gene_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_gene_cases[x, "Gene_start"])} else if(as.numeric(eqtls_gene_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) > as.numeric(eqtls_gene_cases[x, "Gene_end"])){as.numeric(eqtls_gene_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_gene_cases[x, "Gene_end"])} else {0}))

# Transcript eQTLS ALL
dist.transcript <- unlist(lapply(1:length(eqtls_transcript$SNP), function(x) if(as.numeric(eqtls_transcript[x, "SNP_pos"]) < as.numeric(eqtls_transcript[x, "Transcript_start"])){ as.numeric(eqtls_transcript[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_transcript[x, "Transcript_start"])} else if(as.numeric(eqtls_transcript[x, "SNP_pos"]) > as.numeric(eqtls_transcript[x, "Transcript_end"])){as.numeric(eqtls_transcript[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_transcript[x, "Transcript_end"])} else {0}))

# Transcript eQTLS CASES only
dist.transcript.cases <- unlist(lapply(1:length(eqtls_transcript_cases$SNP), function(x) if(as.numeric(eqtls_transcript_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) < as.numeric(eqtls_transcript_cases[x, "Transcript_start"])){ as.numeric(eqtls_transcript_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_transcript_cases[x, "Transcript_start"])} else if(as.numeric(eqtls_transcript_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) > as.numeric(eqtls_transcript_cases[x, "Transcript_end"])){as.numeric(eqtls_transcript_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_transcript_cases[x, "Transcript_end"])} else {0}))

# Exon eQTLS ALL
dist.exon <- unlist(lapply(1:length(eqtls_exon$SNP), function(x) if(as.numeric(eqtls_exon[x, "SNP_pos"]) < as.numeric(eqtls_exon[x, "Exon_start"])){ as.numeric(eqtls_exon[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_exon[x, "Exon_start"])} else if(as.numeric(eqtls_exon[x, "SNP_pos"]) > as.numeric(eqtls_exon[x, "Exon_end"])){as.numeric(eqtls_exon[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_exon[x, "Exon_end"])} else {0}))

# Exon eQTLS CASES only
dist.exon.cases <- unlist(lapply(1:length(eqtls_exon_cases$SNP), function(x) if(as.numeric(eqtls_exon_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) < as.numeric(eqtls_exon_cases[x, "Exon_start"])){ as.numeric(eqtls_exon_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_exon_cases[x, "Exon_start"])} else if(as.numeric(eqtls_exon_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) > as.numeric(eqtls_exon_cases[x, "Exon_end"])){as.numeric(eqtls_exon_cases[x, "SNP_pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls_exon_cases[x, "Exon_end"])} else {0}))


# 3. generate distance plot
### GENE
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/figures/6_distance_plot_gene_eqtls.pdf", height = 5)
plot(density(dist.gene[dist.gene != 0 & dist.gene > -1000000 & dist.gene < 1000000]), xlab = "Position relative to gene (kb)", ylab = "Density", main = "", col = viridis(3)[1], ylim = c(0, 8e-06))
lines(density(dist.gene.cases[dist.gene.cases != 0 & dist.gene.cases > -1000000 & dist.gene.cases < 1000000]), col = viridis(3)[2])
legend("topright", legend = c("genes all", "genes cases only"), fill = c(viridis(3)[1],viridis(3)[2]))
dev.off()

### Transcript
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/figures/6_distance_plot_transcript_eqtls.pdf", height = 5)
plot(density(dist.transcript[dist.transcript != 0 & dist.transcript > -1000000 & dist.transcript < 1000000]), xlab = "Distance of transcript eQTL-variant to TSS and TES", ylab = "Density", main = "", col = viridis(3)[1], ylim = c(0, 6e-06))
lines(density(dist.transcript.cases[dist.transcript.cases != 0 & dist.transcript.cases > -1000000 & dist.transcript.cases < 1000000]), col = viridis(3)[2])
legend("topright", legend = c("transcripts all", "transcripts cases only"), fill = c(viridis(3)[1],viridis(3)[2]))

### Exon
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/figures/6_distance_plot_exon_eqtls.pdf", height = 5)
plot(density(dist.exon[dist.exon != 0 & dist.exon > -1000000 & dist.exon < 1000000]), xlab = "Distance of exon eQTL-variant to ESS and EES", ylab = "Density", main = "", col = viridis(3)[1], ylim = c(0, 7e-06))
lines(density(dist.exon.cases[dist.exon.cases != 0]), col = viridis(3)[2])
legend("topright", legend = c("exons all", "exons cases only"), fill = c(viridis(3)[1], virids(3)[2]))
dev.off()

# all combined
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/figures/6_distance_plot_gene_transcript_exon_eqtls.pdf", height = 5)
plot(density(dist.gene[dist.gene != 0 & dist.gene > -1000000 & dist.gene < 1000000]), xlab = "Distance to TSS/ESS and TES/EES", ylab = "Density", main = "", col = viridis(6)[1], ylim = c(0, 8e-06))
lines(density(dist.gene.cases[dist.gene.cases != 0 & dist.gene.cases > -1000000 & dist.gene.cases < 1000000]), col = viridis(6)[2])
lines(density(dist.transcript[dist.transcript != 0 & dist.transcript > -1000000 & dist.transcript < 1000000]), col = viridis(6)[3])

lines(density(dist.exon.cases[dist.exon.cases != 0]), col = viridis(6)[6])

|                          | Only SCZ | Only CTL | ALL | 
|--------------------------|----------|----------|-----------|
| significant cis-eQTLs    | `r length(eqtls.scz$gene)` | `r length(eqtls.ctl$gene)` | `r length(eqtls.all$gene)` | 
| eQTLs lying on gene      | `r length(dist.scz[dist.scz == 0])` | `r length(dist.ctl[dist.ctl == 0])` | `r length(dist.all[dist.all == 0])` | 
| min distance all         | `r min(dist.scz)` | `r min(dist.ctl)` | `r min(dist.all)` | 
| min distance not on gene | `r min(dist.scz[dist.scz != 0])` | `r min(dist.ctl[dist.ctl != 0])` | `r min(dist.all[dist.all != 0])` | 
| max distance             | `r max(dist.scz)` | `r max(dist.ctl)` | `r max(dist.all)` | 
| mean distance            | `r mean(dist.scz)` | `r mean(dist.ctl)` | `r mean(dist.all)` | 
| median distance          | `r median(dist.scz)` | `r median(dist.ctl)` | `r median(dist.all)` |
```

## Scatterplots

### eQTLs vs. own GWAS

Gene eQTLs vs. own GWAS:
```{r, echo = F}
# Load GWAS results
gwas_results <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/01.GWAS/02_GWAS_results/pmb_info06_all_chr_maf0.01_merged_samples_filtered_GWAS_with_covar.assoc.logistic", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, data.table = F, select =  c("SNP", "P"))

gwas_eqtl_snps <- merge(gesnps, gwas_results, by = "SNP") # merge the two datasets (not overlapping SNPs will be removed from the dataset)
gwas_eqtl_snps$log_Pvalue <- -log10(gwas_eqtl_snps$`P-value`)
gwas_eqtl_snps$log_P <- -log10(gwas_eqtl_snps$P)

  xlab("-log10(P) of gene eQTL SNPs")
```

## Barplot: VEP SNP-annotation

```{r}
dat <- fread(paste0(anno_path, "/01_VEP/pmb_cis-eQTL_annotation_results_10000_permutations_VEP_all_states.tsv"), header = T, data.table = F)  # read in data
row.names(dat) <- dat$V1  # change rownames
dat <- dat[,  c("Gene", "Transcript", "Exon")]  # get cases vs. control data
dat$V1 <- NULL# remove rowname column
dat[dat == "<= 1e-04"] <- "0.0001"
dat[] <- lapply(dat, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
# get all OR
dat_or <- dat[endsWith(rownames(dat), "_or"), ]
dat_or$element <- lapply(rownames(dat_or), function(x) substr(x, 1 , nchar(x) - 7))
dat_or <- melt(dat_or, id = "element") 
colnames(dat_or) <- c("element", "variable", "or")
# get all p-values
dat_pval <- dat[endsWith(rownames(dat), "_pVal"), ] 
dat_pval$element <- lapply(rownames(dat_pval), function(x) substr(x, 1 , nchar(x) - 9))  
dat_pval <- melt(dat_pval, id = "element") 
dat_pval$value <- -log10(dat_pval$value)
colnames(dat_pval) <- c("element", "variable", "-log10(p-value)")
# get all overlaps
dat_overlap <- dat[endsWith(rownames(dat), "_overlap"), ]
dat_overlap$element <- lapply(rownames(dat_overlap), function(x) substr(x, 1 , nchar(x) - 12))
dat_overlap <- melt(dat_overlap, id = "element") 
colnames(dat_overlap) <- c("element", "variable", "overlap")
# get proportion of SNPs found in the states
snp_counts <- rbind("Gene" = 41352, "Transcript" = 99009, "Exon" = 260462)
dat_overlap$percentdt <- sapply(1:length(dat_overlap$overlap), function(x) dat_overlap[x, "overlap"] / snp_counts[unlist(dat_overlap[x, "variable"]), 1])
# merge all 
dat_all <- merge(dat_or, dat_overlap, by = c("element", "variable"))
dat_all <- melt(dat_all, id = c("element", "variable"))
colnames(dat_all) <- c("element", "type", "variable", "value")
dat_all <- dat_all[dat_all$element != "Quies", ]
dat_all <- dat_all[dat_all$variable == "or" | dat_all$variable == "percentdt" | dat_all$variable == "percentcmc" | dat_all$variable == "percentgtex", ]
# generate barplot
ggplot(dat_all, aes(x = as.character(element), y = as.numeric(value), fill = type)) + theme_minimal() +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) + ylab("") + xlab("") + coord_flip() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(3, option = "D", begin = 0.15, end = 0.9)) + ggtitle("Variant Effect Predictor (VEP)") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_x", labeller = as_labeller(c(`or` = "Odds ratio", `percentdt` = "Proportion")))
ggsave(paste0(out_path, "/8_Brain_resampling_VEP_pmb_or_and_proportion.pdf"), width = 6, height = 4)

# get proportions to CMC and GTEx
dat <- fread(paste0(anno_path, "/01_VEP/CMC_GTEx_SNP_overlap_to_VEP_all_states.tsv"), header = T, data.table = F) 
# read in data
row.names(dat) <- dat$V1  # change rownames
dat <- dat[,  c("CMC_eQTL", "CMC_isoQTL", "GTEx_eQTL_brain", "GTEx_sQTL_brain")]  # getcases vs. control data

# get all CMC

dat_cmc$element <- rownames(dat_cmc)
```

# FUMA: KEGG gene set enrichment

## Load data

First, we will load the gene set enrichment analysis datasets (as we only had results for teGenes and eeGenes, we will load only these datasets).
```{r, echo = F}
hit_gene_sets <- list()  # get all unique gene set names of significant gene sets
# FUMA geGene results
geGenes_fuma <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/7.2_gene_eQTLs/GS.txt"))
geGenes_fuma <- geGenes_fuma[geGenes_fuma$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt", ]
geGenes_fuma <- geGenes_fuma[geGenes_fuma$adjP < 0.05, ]
print(paste0("Significant gene sets for geGenes (cases and controls): ", dim(geGenes_fuma)[[1]][1]))  # no significant enriched gene sets
# FUMA geGene cases only results
geGenes_cases_fuma <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/7.2_gene_eQTLs_cases/GS.txt"))
geGenes_cases_fuma <- geGenes_cases_fuma[geGenes_cases_fuma$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt", ]
geGenes_cases_fuma <- geGenes_cases_fuma[geGenes_cases_fuma$adjP < 0.05, ]
print(paste0("Significant gene sets for geGenes (cases only): ", dim(geGenes_fuma)[[1]][1]))  # no significant enriched gene sets

# FUMA teGene results
teGenes_fuma <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/7.3_transcript_eQTLs/GS.txt"))
teGenes_fuma$GeneRatio <- teGenes_fuma$N_overlap / teGenes_fuma$N_genes
teGenes_fuma <- teGenes_fuma[teGenes_fuma$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & teGenes_fuma$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
teGenes_fuma$log_adjP <- -log10(teGenes_fuma$adjP)
print(paste0("Significant gene sets for teGenes (cases and controls): ", dim(teGenes_fuma)[[1]][1]))  # no significant enriched gene sets
hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, teGenes_fuma$GeneSet)
# FUMA teGene cases only results
teGenes_cases_fuma <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/7.3_transcript_eQTLs_cases/GS.txt"))
teGenes_cases_fuma$GeneRatio <- teGenes_cases_fuma$N_overlap / teGenes_cases_fuma$N_genes
teGenes_cases_fuma <- teGenes_cases_fuma[teGenes_cases_fuma$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & teGenes_cases_fuma$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
teGenes_cases_fuma <- teGenes_cases_fuma[teGenes_cases_fuma$adjP < 0.05, ]
teGenes_cases_fuma$log_adjP <- -log10(teGenes_cases_fuma$adjP)
print(paste0("Significant gene sets for teGenes (cases only): ", dim(teGenes_cases_fuma)[[1]][1]))  # no significant enriched gene sets
hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, teGenes_fuma$GeneSet)

# FUMA eeGene results
eeGenes_fuma <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/7.4_exon_eQTLs/GS.txt"))
# get only pathway name and all overlapping genes + separate genes for the barplot
kegg_genes <- eeGenes_fuma[eeGenes_fuma$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & eeGenes_fuma$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "N_overlap", "genes")]
kegg_genes <- separate_rows(kegg_genes, genes, sep = ":")
eeGenes_fuma$GeneRatio <- eeGenes_fuma$N_overlap / eeGenes_fuma$N_genes
eeGenes_fuma <- eeGenes_fuma[eeGenes_fuma$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & eeGenes_fuma$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
eeGenes_fuma <- eeGenes_fuma[eeGenes_fuma$adjP < 0.05, ]
eeGenes_fuma$log_adjP <- -log10(eeGenes_fuma$adjP)
print(paste0("Significant gene sets for teGenes (cases and controls): ", dim(eeGenes_fuma)[[1]][1]))  # no significant enriched gene sets
hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, eeGenes_fuma$GeneSet)
# FUMA teGene cases only results
eeGenes_cases_fuma <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/7.4_exon_eQTLs_cases/GS.txt"))
eeGenes_cases_fuma$GeneRatio <- eeGenes_cases_fuma$N_overlap / eeGenes_cases_fuma$N_genes
eeGenes_cases_fuma <- eeGenes_cases_fuma[eeGenes_cases_fuma$Category == "4_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt" & eeGenes_cases_fuma$adjP < 0.05, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio", "adjP")]
eeGenes_cases_fuma <- eeGenes_cases_fuma[eeGenes_cases_fuma$adjP < 0.05, ]
eeGenes_cases_fuma$log_adjP <- -log10(eeGenes_cases_fuma$adjP)
print(paste0("Significant gene sets for teGenes (cases only): ", dim(eeGenes_cases_fuma)[[1]][1]))  # no significant enriched gene sets
hit_gene_sets <- c(hit_gene_sets, eeGenes_cases_fuma$GeneSet)
length(unique(hit_gene_sets))
```

Load exon diff expr data. 
```{r, echo = F}
load(paste0(dea_path, "/3.4_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.RData"))
top_hits <- top_hits[, c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "LogFC")]
top_hits$Reg <- ifelse(top_hits$LogFC < 0, "Down", "Up")
top_hits$`Ensembl Gene ID` <- sapply(top_hits$`Ensembl Gene ID`, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])
```

## Get up-/down-regulated genes

Now, we can calculate how many of the genes were up/downregulated using the top hits loaded in the gene set enrichment and add it to the dataset. Then, we will transform the data into a ggplot readable format. 
```{r, echo = F}
kegg_genes <- data.frame(merge(kegg_genes, top_hits[, c("Gene Symbol", "Reg")], by.x = "genes", by.y = "Gene Symbol", all.x = T))
kegg_genes <- aggregate(Reg ~ GeneSet + N_overlap, data = as.data.frame(kegg_genes), FUN = function(x){table(x)})
eeGenes_fuma_kegg <- merge(eeGenes_fuma, kegg_genes, by = "GeneSet")[, c("GeneSet", "N_overlap", "log_adjP", "Reg.Down", "Reg.Up")]
# Now, we need the percentage of up/down regulated genes for log_adjP
eeGenes_fuma_kegg$Reg.Down <- (eeGenes_fuma_kegg$log_adjP / eeGenes_fuma_kegg$N_overlap) * eeGenes_fuma_kegg$Reg.Down
eeGenes_fuma_kegg$Reg.Up <- (eeGenes_fuma_kegg$log_adjP / eeGenes_fuma_kegg$N_overlap) * eeGenes_fuma_kegg$Reg.Up
# And we need to form the data into ggplot format
eeGenes_fuma_kegg <- melt(data = eeGenes_fuma_kegg, id.vars = "GeneSet", measure.vars = c("Reg.Down", "Reg.Up"))
```

## Barplot

Generate a barplot including the results of the enriched (FDR <= 0.05) KEGG gene sets. 
```{r, echo = F}
# barplot without up/downregulated genes colored
g <- ggplot(eeGenes_fuma_kegg, aes(y = value, x = reorder(GeneSet, order(GeneSet, decreasing = T)), fill = variable)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(3, 9)], name = "", labels = c("Down-regulated", "Up-regulated")) +
    ylab(bquote("-log"["10"]*"(adjP)")) +
    xlab("") +
    ggtitle("eeGenes: KEGG pathways") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01)) +
    theme(axis.ticks = element_line(colour = NA), text = element_text(size = 16), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(out_path, "/3_barplot_eeGenes_FUMA_KEGG_up_down_reg_genes.pdf"), width = 11, height = 12)
g
dev.off()
rm(eeGenes_fuma_kegg, kegg_genes, top_hits, design, fit, g)
```

## Balloonplot

Now, we can generate the dataset for the plot using all gene sets that had a hit in at least one eGene set (teGenes or eeGenes for cases & controls or cases only). We will set the p-value to NA if no p-value for a gene set was given. 
```{r, echo = F}
plot_data <- as.data.frame(unique(unlist(hit_gene_sets)))
colnames(plot_data) <- "GeneSet"
# get teGene cases and controls hits
plot_data <- merge(plot_data, teGenes_fuma[, c("GeneSet", "adjP")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "teGene_cc")
# get teGene cases only hits
plot_data <- merge(plot_data, teGenes_cases_fuma[, c("GeneSet", "adjP")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "teGenes_cc", "teGenes_co")
# get eeGene cases and controls hits
plot_data <- merge(plot_data, eeGenes_fuma[, c("GeneSet", "adjP")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "teGenes_cc", "teGenes_co", "eeGenes_cc")
# get eeGene cases only hits
plot_data <- merge(plot_data, eeGenes_cases_fuma[, c("GeneSet", "adjP")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "teGenes_cc", "teGenes_co", "eeGenes_cc", "eeGenes_co")
plot_data <- reshape2::melt(data = plot_data, id.vars = "GeneSet")

### get gene ratios
grs <- as.data.frame(unique(unlist(hit_gene_sets)))
colnames(grs) <- "GeneSet"
# get teGene cases and controls hits
grs <- merge(grs, teGenes_fuma[, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(grs) <- c("GeneSet", "teGene_cc")
# get teGene cases only hits
grs <- merge(grs, teGenes_cases_fuma[, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(grs) <- c("GeneSet", "teGenes_cc", "teGenes_co")
# get eeGene cases and controls hits
grs <- merge(grs, eeGenes_fuma[, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(grs) <- c("GeneSet", "teGenes_cc", "teGenes_co", "eeGenes_cc")
# get eeGene cases only hits
grs <- merge(grs, eeGenes_cases_fuma[, c("GeneSet", "GeneRatio")], by = "GeneSet", all.x = T)
colnames(grs) <- c("GeneSet", "teGenes_cc", "teGenes_co", "eeGenes_cc", "eeGenes_co")
grs <- reshape2::melt(data = grs, id.vars = "GeneSet")

plot_data <- merge(plot_data, grs, by = c("GeneSet", "variable"))
colnames(plot_data) <- c("GeneSet", "eeGenes", "adjP", "GeneRatio")
plot_data$log_adjP <- -log(plot_data$adjP)
plot_data <- plot_data[!(duplicated(plot_data)), ]
```

Then, we will generate a ggballoonplot including the results of the enriched (FDR < 0.05) KEGG gene sets for teGenes of cases and controls, the teGenes of cases only, the eeGenes of cases and controls and the eeGenes of cases only.
```{r, echo = F}
g <- ggballoonplot(plot_data, x = "eeGenes", y = "GeneSet", fill = "log_adjP", size = "GeneRatio", ggtheme = theme_bw(), legend.title = "-log10(adjP)", size.range = c(1, 6), color = "lightgray") +
              scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", direction = 1)
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(out_path, "/3_balloonplot_eeGenes_FUMA_KEGG.pdf"), width = 5, height = 12)
```
